theorems.name: Submission.dph_lpfex_support_subset_closure_image
theorems.statement: ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m'), (∀ n, Continuous (Gj n)) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop X.support → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) → S.support ⊆ closure (G '' X.support)
